name: Google Cloud Run
free_limit: Request-based Cloud Run Free Tier: 2M requests, 180,000 vCPU-seconds and 360,000 GiB-seconds of memory/month; 1 GB eligible North America outbound transfer
watch_out: Requires an active Cloud Billing account and valid payment method. The request-based Free Tier differs from instance-based billing; Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, logging, network egress and other products may charge separately. Paid billing accounts are charged for usage beyond the free allowance; a Free Trial account draws from its limited trial credit.
